QuestInfo.name: Chief Stan's Reply
QuestInfo.0: #p202# in #m10001000# seems to want to send a reply to #p800018# in the #m80002000#.
QuestInfo.1: #p202# in #m10001000# asked me to deliver a reply to #p800018# in the #m80002000#.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #p202#'s letter to #p800018# in the #m80002000#.

0.0: To be honest, I was quite worried when I first heard about creating a Free Market. All kinds of crowds will gather, and dangerous items could end up being traded, couldn't they? However, if the Free Market thrives, it will be a good thing for our #m10001000# as well. It is true that more adventurers will gather, revitalizing the town.
0.1: Very well. I shall discuss this matter with the townspeople. Now, take this letter and deliver it to that young man, #p800018#.

1.0: Oh, #p202# sent a reply! I really hope he looks at this project positively... Let's see what it says.

item.0: You say #p202# wrote a reply? But wait, where is the letter?

lost.0: It seems you lost my letter. I told you to be careful with it. I will write it again for you, so make sure you do not lose it this time.
